headline: A new AP-NORC poll finds that most Americans think AI is developing too fast, and few trust either party to handle it.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a major national poll on AI, new on 8 Oct 2026.
importance_line: Most Americans want AI kept under human control and workers protected, yet Congress left for the midterm campaign without passing a major AI law; the poll measures opinion, not what AI will actually do.
summary: The Associated Press reports that its AP-NORC poll found 64% of Americans think AI is developing too fast, against 27% who say the pace is about right and 8% who say it is too slow. Nearly 80% said it is at least very important for the government to keep AI under human control and to protect jobs, and about 40% said they trust neither party to handle the issue.
notes: AP page blocked; facts read in a KEYE/CBS Austin (TNND) article that reports the AP-NORC poll.
